properties.notes: Centroid 16.06N, 73.47E. Approx polygon bbox derived from published boundary description. Full boundary in WDPA (auth download required). Covers coral reefs and rocky substrate off Sindhudurg coast. Area: core 3.2 km2 + buffer 25.95 km2 = 29.12 km2 total.
